name: Commemoration of Jubilees/Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.- **Auditorium/Hall Provision:** Provision of an auditorium or hall by the Tiatr Academy of Goa to stage the programme.- **Additional Financial Assistance for Village Programmes:** An additional amount as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for hall charges or stage erection charges if the programme is held in a village.- **P
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an organizing institution or an individual. - The applicant must propose a programme to celebrate jubilee/birth anniversaries of artistes of yesteryears who are no longer living. - The applicant must ensure the programme aims to make the younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of these Tiatr artistes. - The applicant must ensure the programme includes the narration of the history of the life of the late artiste to whom the programme is dedicated. - The applicant must ensure the family members of the deceased artiste are compulsorily invited for the function. - The applicant must give the proposal well in advance, providing all details of the programme, including typed script and lyrics to be presented, and the names of the artistes. - The applicant must insert/publish/announce "This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa" in all advertisements, whether oral, print, or electronic media, and on banners. - The applicant must display the Tiatr Academy of Goa’s banner on the front side wing of the stage if it is a Tiatr, and return it after all shows. - The applicant must display a banner of minimum size 6ft.x10 ft. carrying the Tiatr Academy of Goa’s logo as a back drop if it is a Musical Show. - The applicant must discuss with the Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide about the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour well in advance. - The applicant must ensure the President/Vice President of the Tiatr Academy of Goa will either be the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour at the function. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the programme is at least 2 hours. - The applicant must ensure there are no adverse remarks made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting religious sentiments.
